Yukon Oil and Gas Exploration Regions. Based on the Resource Assessments completed and the 2003 Yukon Digital Bedrock Geology. Created by Oil and Gas Management Branch under guidance from Yukon Geological Survey.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.
